hooks.command:
input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; cd "$d" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
[ -x ../../../comfy-env/bin/python ] || exit 0
git status --porcelain -- py tests conftest.py 2>/dev/null | grep -q . || exit 0
PY=../../../comfy-env/bin/python
clean() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -vE 'RuntimeWarning|<frozen site>'; }
out=$($PY -m ruff check py tests conftest.py 2>&1); rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  { echo "Stop gate: ruff check failed. Fix before finishing."; clean "$out"; } >&2; exit 2
fi
out=$($PY -m ruff format --check py tests conftest.py 2>&1); rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  { echo "Stop gate: ruff format check failed. Run ruff format."; clean "$out"; } >&2; exit 2
fi
exit 0

input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
st=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)
echo "$st" | awk '{print $NF}' | grep -qE '\.(py|ts|tsx|js|jsx|html|scss|css)$' || exit 0
echo "$st" | grep -q '\.serena/memories/' && exit 0
echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "Stop", "additionalContext": "Uncommitted code changes are present and no Serena memory was touched. If this turn introduced new conventions, patterns, services, or structural changes, update the relevant memory (mem:core, mem:conventions, mem:tech_stack, mem:task_completion) via mcp__serena__write_memory."}}'
exit 0
